claim: Try it with sample data opens three named readings in demo-only storage, with the first reading visible on a 390 × 844 screen.
sandbox: fresh 390 × 844 browser; click the landing action; assert question, value, state, freshness, card count, viewport bounds, and demo-only key; repeat at ?demo=1

claim: Demo links use d_ IDs; Reset demo and Start for real revoke them and clear every demo key without changing real data.
where: demo banner, privacy page, README, demo documentation
sandbox: pre-seed exact real question, preview, and share sentinels; create a d_ link before each exit; prove Reset and Start each return the link as 410, remove every old demo key, and preserve all real values

claim: Saved question cards retain and show owner, freshness limit, threshold, and approved source after reload.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the first card's exact four fields and source URL before and after reload

claim: Question cards stay in browser storage; normal reading workflows make no analytics, account, ingestion, query, or alert requests.
where: landing facts, boundaries, privacy page, README
sandbox: record every request while loading and updating demo data; inspect storage, absent account/analytics/query/alert controls, and boundary copy

claim: Question editing, CSV import, JSON download, and expiring links work without an account, purchase, or checkout.
sandbox: fresh demo; complete an edit, import, JSON download, and expiring-link creation; assert no password or checkout

claim: The question book marks readings on track, needs attention, or stale from their threshold and freshness limit.
sandbox: fresh demo plus a current failing reading; assert all three states and the visible freshness limit

claim: The visited demo reopens offline with its saved sample readings.
sandbox: fresh demo; wait for service worker, reload once, set browser offline, reload, and assert offline notice plus all cards

claim: Creating or opening an expiring link needs a connection and recovers after reconnecting.
sandbox: create a demo answer; go offline; assert plain create/open errors; reconnect and complete both actions

claim: Updating a recurring reading changes its existing card without making a duplicate.
sandbox: fresh demo; update first value, assert three cards and new value before and after reload

claim: CSV import adds new named questions and updates a matching question without duplicates.
sandbox: fresh demo; import one named row twice with different values; assert one matching card with latest value

claim: The form and CSV require named fields, HTTPS source URLs, and whole-minute freshness from 1 through 10,080.
sandbox: fresh demo; submit blank fields, malformed HTTPS, 0, 1, 1.5, 10,080, and 10,081 through both input paths; inspect accepted CSV storage at 10,080

claim: CSV comparison accepts gte, lte, or eq, and observedAt accepts valid ISO dates.
sandbox: fresh demo; import all three comparisons and valid ISO forms; reject an unknown comparison and impossible or malformed dates

claim: Download CSV template produces the required headers and one sample row.
sandbox: fresh demo; download and compare the filename, complete header row, and every field in the single sample row exactly

claim: Export question book CSV downloads every card in the current workspace and imports without duplicates.
sandbox: pre-seed real sentinel; export demo; assert only three demo cards; import twice into an empty real workspace and compare cards

claim: Demo previews use separate browser storage, stay out of URLs, and ignore legacy URL fragments.
sandbox: pre-seed a real preview; create a demo preview; compare the untouched real value and demo key, inspect the URL, then clear storage and open a forged legacy fragment

claim: Download JSON exports the reviewed redacted answer and the UI states that downloaded files do not expire.
sandbox: create a redacted demo preview; assert the warning; download and compare the exact key set, answer, status, observed and created times, filename, and complete object with the reviewed preview

claim: An expiring link uses a random ID with no answer data, rejects changed IDs, and stops working after server expiry.
where: answer-copy preview, shared answer route, README
sandbox: create from demo; inspect random-ID URL; request original and changed ID; create a one-second fixture and assert HTTP 410 after expiry

claim: Expiring links can be set to 1 hour, 24 hours, or 7 days.
sandbox: fresh demo; select each option; assert the request sends 3600, 86400, or 604800 seconds and the returned expiry matches the selected duration within five seconds

claim: A redacted expiring link does not store or show owner, source, or internal note.
where: answer-copy control, shared answer route, privacy page
sandbox: create default-redacted demo link; inspect server response fields and recipient page

claim: The creator can revoke an expiring link immediately.
sandbox: create demo link; assert it opens; revoke through UI; assert server returns HTTP 410

claim: The form saves approved HTTPS links and never asks for dashboard credentials.
sandbox: fresh real question book; complete a valid HTTPS save; inspect resulting source link, warning, and absence of password inputs

claim: Every demo card links to a working local sample source page with its own title.
sandbox: fresh demo; request and render all three source paths; assert 200, sample warning, and distinct document title

claim: Stored answer-copy data is removed automatically at expiry without a later recipient request.
sandbox: fake Azure Queue clock; create a one-second answer; inspect exact metadata and payload storage after expiry without reading the link

claim: Sharing metadata keeps only link controls; revocation deletes the stored answer immediately.
sandbox: fake Azure Table and Queue; compare the exact metadata keys, revoke, and assert the queue contains no answer data

claim: Create, open, and revoke routes share 100 requests per network address per 60 seconds; request 101 returns 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: invoke all three route handlers with one platform-appended forwarding hop while rotating caller-supplied prefixes and Azure-named client headers; assert combined request 101 is 429 and a second trusted hop remains allowed

claim: The read-only health route stays available outside the sharing request limit.
sandbox: call the health handler 200 times; assert every response is 200, contains only health/build fields, and has no rate-limit headers

claim: Deployment stamps the static artifact and server API with the same committed BUILD_ID, then verifies both identities and the forged-header limit.
sandbox: stub git, npm, Azure CLI, and the deploy helper; assert build, exact commit setting, upload, and live verification receive the same 40-character commit; run the live verifier against a local server with matching static/API IDs and reject a mismatched static marker

claim: The legacy cleanup migrates active answers to expiring storage and removes expired answers.
sandbox: fake Azure Table and Queue storage; seed one active and one expired legacy answer; run migration without reading either link; assert one migration and one removal
